name: @singularity/plugin-plugin-meta-token-usage
description: Which theme tokens a plugin's source uses, and which plugin owns each one: the static defineTokenGroup reader (owner + CSS vars) and the token-usage scanner (literal var(--x) plus Tailwind classes resolved by Tailwind's own design system over app.css). Feeds the cross-refs facet's tokenUses, which the closure engine turns into hard edges.
